blight_signs.jaymoskingdoms.cough.1: Keep back. I know that cough.

blight_signs.jaymoskingdoms.healer.2: Stop there, %s. That's the blight on you. It can still be burned out.
blight_signs.jaymoskingdoms.healer.3: Who bit you, %s? That isn't healing. It's spreading.
